intro: A working summary of what the system must do — what the team plans, estimates and staffs from. The AI drafts it from the request, the clarification interview and the initial analysis; the team checks and edits it. The SRS stays the formal signed document.

hint.objective: The business problem and what the system must achieve
hint.users: Roles, departments, how many people, shifts
hint.features: One capability per line, most important first
hint.integrations: One system / file / machine per line — direction and data
hint.environment: PC, tablet on the shop floor, mobile…
hint.constraints: Permissions, approvals, IATF / ISO, PDPA, performance — one per line
hint.open_questions: What is still missing or undecided — one per line

emptyPlan: No requirement summary yet. Let the AI draft one from the request, then check and save it.
aiDraft: AI draft — not saved yet. Check every section, edit what is wrong, then save.
aiUnedited: Drafted by AI and saved without edits — worth a check.
notesPlaceholder: Paste meeting notes, e-mails or decisions made after the request — the AI treats them as newer than the request.
updateHelp: The AI keeps your edits and adds what is new.
generating: The AI is reading the request… this can take a minute.
off: AI is not set up on this server.
failed: Could not reach the AI — please try again.

discard.title: Discard the AI draft?
discard.description: The draft has not been saved.

noRequest: Created without a request — paste the requirements in the box above for the AI to work from.
